title: Long delay radio echoes heard by Norwegian operators

tellings.quote: The story begins back in 1927. Norwegian shortwave radio operators began to notice something odd.

plain: In 1927, Norwegian shortwave radio operators began to notice something odd: radio signals that seemed to come back as echoes after a long delay, a puzzle tied to the Norwegian scientist Karl Stormer. Michels tells it himself, as the start of a story, in an episode with the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, who looks for signs of unexplained objects around Earth; the hint is that something out in space might have been sending the signals back.
